name: Firefox media webhook plugin for Home Assistant

mentions.name: Firefox media webhook plugin for Home Assistant
mentions.description: A Firefox browser plugin that sends webhooks to Home Assistant based on media playback. It automatically adjusts lighting when media starts, pauses, and stops (e.g., turning on accent lighting when a movie is paused and off when resumed), and calculates the dominant color of the playing content to feed Home Assistant, driving an LED strip behind the TV as a budget ambilight. Planned next step is automatically tracking watched content to generate viewing-habit statistics.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the last month I've worked on a firefox plugin that allows me to send webhooks to my home assistant.
